notes:
Account snapshot:
- Company: Bluepine Product Ops — product analytics platform used by mid-market SaaS customers (in-app search, support triage, automated summaries).
- Current preference: start on Redwood Hosted API for quick integration; plan to evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput + data isolation if unit economics work.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs pushed to their SIEM, customer-managed KMS for key wrap. Data residency: US-only for now (legal reasons).
- POC details: 2-week hosted POC started 2026-01-27. Focus paths: doc-search (embeddings), chat summarization (streaming), and reranking for search results. Provided two sample datasets (support tickets + docs).
- Workshop 2026-02-07 (cost optimization): ran batching/caching scenarios with Redwood SEs. Key takeaways:
  * Batching: continuous batching reduces per-token GPU time for embeddings workload by ~35% in staging sim; need to lock batch windows for real traffic.
  * KV / prefix caching: reranking + chat sessions showed 18-25% token reduction when reusing session KV cache.
  * Quantization: ran q4_8bit and q5_4bit experiments — q5_4bit reduced inference cost by ~42% but introduced small perf drift on abstractive summarization (ROUGE drop ~1.6 pts); team wants more evals on safety/regression.
  * Unit economics: SE provided a model showing hosted tier cost ~ $0.14 / 1k tokens for current config vs estimated Dedicated unit cost $0.05–0.07 / 1k tokens after batching + quant. That gap is the main business case for Dedicated.
- Customer quote: "We need predictable costs at scale — if you can show stable QoE + half the cost, Dedicated is compelling." — VP Product (call 1/22).
- Internal stakeholders: VP Product (champion), Infra Lead (procurement gate), Security (SAML/KMS signoff), Finance (ARR thresholds).
- Deal dynamics: leaning toward Redwood but wants final POC on Dedicated performance and a written fallback policy for capacity spikes. Procurement estimate: end-of-March decision if POC shows cost & QoE.
- Open items: formal quantization accuracy regression report, Dedicated trial contract terms, data residency addendum, SLA for 99.9% with penalties.
- Quick win: recommended small config change (increase batch window for embeddings) already validated in staging — expect immediate ~12% cost drop on current hosted POC.
- Next conv: cost-optimization workshop follow-up to run Dedicated trial (2-week) starting 2026-02-15 pending procurement sign-off.
